subject: Detailed performer profiles and song construction
question: Owner-directed expansion of the creative collective into practical performer knowledge
decision: Create an individual master-audit log for every performer, detailing musical skills, knowledge, techniques, styles and performance attributes, and use those profiles in the construction of each song. Parallel profile-research chats were explicitly requested. Profile content and exact musical realizations remain reviewable design work; no new composition or release acceptance is implied.

subject: Bonobo as the producer identity
question: Owner-selected single artistic identity for the producer
decision: Bonobo is the ideal single primary artistic identity for the producer. Continue profile and soundtrack design around this coherent centre; earlier pop, bright dance, retro glitch-hop and console/chip capabilities remain contextual requirements rather than equal competing producer identities. This resolves the earlier uncertainty about Quantic or a single primary reference and grants no composition or release acceptance.

subject: Percussion Factory added to the instrument resources
question: Owner report of newly added soundbank
decision: Percussion Factory has been added and should be considered a meaningful soundbank resource for the project. Exact installed edition, programs, mapping and performance behavior still require native verification before claiming audition or production readiness.
